subject.title: Android: add adaptive app navigation sidebar

question: Should the Android app adopt this Material adaptive navigation-model replacement after final-head coverage demonstrates the compact, rail, and drawer experiences?
rationale: The patch changes the app’s primary navigation presentation across device classes; final visual behavior and the intended product layout require maintainer acceptance beyond unit-level mode-selection coverage.

options.title: Sponsor after final coverage
options.body: Request redacted final-head device or emulator proof for compact, rail, and drawer modes, then review the accepted navigation behavior.

options.title: Retain the current shell
options.body: Decline the navigation-model replacement and keep the existing Android sidebar behavior.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Ask for a smaller, separately approved Android navigation change that preserves the current shell structure.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after final coverage
recommendation.body: Request redacted final-head device or emulator proof for compact, rail, and drawer modes, then review the accepted navigation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the latest review-driven compact-navigation repair and are best positioned to route the resulting Android verification evidence.
